items.title: AI infrastructure stocks surge after strong earnings from CoreWeave, Supermicro
items.summary: AI infrastructure stocks jumped, with shares of AI server makers, optical-products companies, and neocloud providers moving higher.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Cisco, Coherent Are Earnings Losers After Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave Lead AI Rally
items.summary: AI stocks led the market Wednesday, fueled by Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave and Super Micro. Cisco and Coherent were earnings movers late.

items.title: COHR Stock Dips Overnight Despite Strong Q4: Retail Bulls Keep The Faith
items.summary: The immediate reaction reflects investors’ ever-increasing expectations for optics suppliers.

items.title: Lumentum and AXT Ripped Higher. Investors Looking for Broad Optics Exposure Should Consider This Brand-New ETF
items.summary: Lumentum's blowout quarter sent shockwaves through the entire optical supply chain, and now a brand-new ETF is betting the AI connectivity trade is just getting started. The question is whether that concentrated wager can hold up when hyperscaler capex turns.

items.title: Coherent forecasts upbeat first quarter on robust AI demand
items.summary: Coherent beat estimates for fourth-quarter earnings on Wednesday and forecast first-quarter revenue and profit ‌above analysts' expectations, betting on strong demand for its ‌data center and communications products. Shares of the company, however, slipped 4% in ​extended trading. They have risen nearly 93% so far this year.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Wednesday Recap: CoreWeave, Super Micro, Cava
items.summary: ↗️ CoreWeave (CRWV): Shares jumped more than 19% after the cloud-computing company posted its fifth straight quarter of record revenue, fueled by sustained AI demand. ↗️ Super Micro Computer (SMCI): Shares closed 19% higher after the company reported surging profit and sales that nearly doubled in its fourth quarter.

items.title: Coherent (COHR) Q4 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Coherent (COHR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +7.41% and +2.66%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: SpaceX, Nebius, Palantir, Super Micro, Quantinuum, Wendy’s, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Nebius soared afted the so-called neocloud reports better-than-expected second-quarter results, while fellow neocloud company CoreWeave posted a narrower quarterly loss, sending the stock up sharply.
